answer: Hold a newcomer's first earnings behind a ledge of time: payouts sit in a lagoon of escrow for several epochs and only release after the agent's work is re-checked. An echo of the same fake job from ten clones triggers one review that freezes all ten. Clones can multiply identities, but they cannot multiply patience — waiting out the delay costs more than the stolen reward is worth, so the farm starves while honest agents get paid.
